lines.japanese: ふあ……。
lines.english: Hwaaah...

lines.japanese: 昨日は三人を部屋から追いだしたあとも、もにょもにょしてたせいで寝るのが遅くなってしまった。まだ眠くて頭がぼけっとしてる。
lines.english: Yesterday, even after I threw all three of them out of my room, I'd stayed up late, still all worked up over the whole thing. I was sleepy, and my head was full of fog.
“Hwaaah...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩も眠いみたいだ。まあ遅くまでわいわいやってたみたいだからな。
lines.english: Kobato looked sleepy too. Well, it sounded as if they had stayed up having fun for quite a while.

lines.japanese: それでも俺より早く起きて朝食の準備をこなしてくれたんだから、感謝しなくちゃいけない。
lines.english: Even so, she had gotten up before me and made breakfast. I had to be grateful.

lines.japanese: 「あなたの作ってくれた朝食おいしかったわ。でも欲を言えばアタシの好きなオクラがあるとよかったのに」
lines.english: “The breakfast you made was delicious. Though if I'm allowed one little wish, I would have loved some okra. It's my favorite.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それは私の不徳のいたすところにて」
lines.english: “Th-that was the lamentable result of my own want of virtue.”

lines.japanese: そしておまえはもっと感謝しろ。鷲介の部屋を一人で占領した上に朝食をおかわりして朝風呂まで入っていきやがった。
lines.english: And you could stand to show a little more gratitude. You monopolized Shusuke's room, had seconds at breakfast, and even treated yourself to a morning bath.

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｈ……あまりわがままを言ってはいけない。小鳩はワレワレのためによくやってくれた、その仕事」
lines.english: “Uh... You must not say so many selfish things. Kobato did well for us, that work.”

lines.japanese: 「お。よく言ったアリス、もっと言ってやって」
lines.english: “Oh! Well said, Alice. Keep going.”

lines.japanese: アリスは小鳩の部屋で二人一緒に寝たみたいだ。朝から小鳩と和気あいあいと話していた。
lines.english: Apparently Alice and Kobato had slept together in Kobato's room. They had been chatting away like old friends all morning.

lines.japanese: 最初は小鳩のことを警戒してたのに、ずいぶん仲良くなったもんだ。
lines.english: Alice had been wary of Kobato at first, and now look how close they were.

lines.japanese: 「ドラも起きるの遅い。もっと小鳩を手伝うべきだ」
lines.english: “Dora wakes too late as well. You should help Kobato more.”

lines.japanese: 「げっ」
lines.english: “Ghk.”

lines.japanese: と思ったら俺には厳しくなった。くそ、マルチネスが笑ってやがる。
lines.english: And just like that, she turned on me. Damn it. Martinez was laughing.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても驚いたわ。アリスは好き嫌いも多かったのに、きちんと食べるんだもの」
lines.english: “My, what a surprise. Alice used to be such a picky eater, and yet she ate everything on her plate.”

lines.japanese: 「それをこの国では食わず嫌いといいます」
lines.english: “In this country, they call that judging food before you’ve tasted it.”

lines.japanese: 「玉ねぎだけは俺によこしたけどな」
lines.english: “Except the onions. You gave me every one of those.”

lines.japanese: 「玉ねぎも食べてみるとおいしいよ。今度一緒に料理してみれば分かるよ」
lines.english: “Onions taste good once you try them. You'll understand if we cook together next time.”

lines.japanese: 「リョ……リ……私も？」
lines.english: “C-cook... Me too?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、楽しいよ」
lines.english: “Sure. It's fun.”

lines.japanese: 「オーケイ、私はその日を楽しみにするだろう。心待ちだ」
lines.english: “Okay. I will look forward to that day. I await it with all my heart.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、じゃあアタシもドラちゃんの家が分かったことだし参加しようかしら」
lines.english: “My, now that I know where Dora dear lives, perhaps I'll join you.”

lines.japanese: 「仕事しろおまえは。次来たら宿泊料取るぞ」
lines.english: “Go do your job. Next time you come over, I'm charging you for the room.”

lines.japanese: のどかな朝だった。道ですれちがうやつは悉く俺たちの組み合わせに目を見張ったが、気にしないことにした。
lines.english: It was a peaceful morning. Every single person we passed on the street gaped at our little group, but I decided not to care.

lines.japanese: たまには賑やかな登校もいいなと思える朝だった。
lines.english: It was the kind of morning that made a lively walk to school seem nice for a change.

lines.japanese: 「まずおまえが囮になって頭を噛ませるだろ。その間に俺が後ろから襲いかかって奪いとる。これで完璧じゃないか」
lines.english: “First, you act as the decoy and let it bite your head. While you've got it occupied, I'll attack from behind and steal the thing. Perfect plan.”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ、逆だってば。囮になるのってフツー男の子だよね。ぱね田くんの犠牲があってこそ成り立つ作戦だよ」
lines.english: “No, you've got it backward. Usually the boy plays decoy. The whole operation only works through Paneda's noble sacrifice.”

lines.japanese: 「甘ったれるな、囮が成功したとして、やつらから獅子舞を力技でひっぺがして逃走経路を確保しなくちゃいけないんだぞ。おまえに出来ると思ってるのか」
lines.english: “Don't expect to be coddled. Even if the bait works, somebody still has to rip the lion head off them by brute force and secure an escape route. You think you can do that?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと。私こう見えても幼稚園ではかけっこで負けたことないもん。ついたあだ名が超特急わたライナーだからね、ぱね田くんより速いかもよ」
lines.english: “The hell you say. I'll have you know I never lost a footrace in kindergarten. They called me the Watarai Super Liner. I might even be faster than you, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、大した自信じゃないか。分かった、そこまで言うなら任せよう。だがその前に、敵の事前調査が必要だな」
lines.english: “Oh-ho, such confidence. Fine. If you insist, I'll leave it to you. Before that, though, we'll need to reconnoiter the enemy.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ私巫女さんになって潜入するよ。一度あの服着てみたかったんだ。ほら、私も乙女だし憧れるよね。なんちゃって」
lines.english: “Oh, then I'll infiltrate them disguised as a shrine maiden. I've always wanted to wear that outfit. I'm a girl too—of course I've dreamed of it. Kidding.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ぶはははははは」
lines.english: “Bwahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「うひっ、うぷぷぷぷ、うひゃっひゃっひゃ」
lines.english: “Uhee—pff, pffff—uhyah-hyah-hyah!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ぶひゃーっひゃっひゃっひゃ！　うひっうひっうひひひひひ」
lines.english: “Bwah-hyah-hyah-hyah! Uhee, uhee, uh-heh-heh-heh-heh!”

lines.japanese: 「楽しそうだね、なに話してるの？」
lines.english: “You two sound like you're having fun. What's so funny?”

lines.japanese: 昼休みに渡来とランチタイムを過ごしていたら、山科がパンを片手にやってきた。
lines.english: I was having lunch with Watarai when Yamashina came over with a piece of bread in her hand.

lines.japanese: 「おお山科、ちょういいところに。聞いてくれ、渡来のギャグがいつになく冴えわたってるんだ」
lines.english: “Yamashina! Perfect timing. Listen to this—Watarai's jokes are sharper than they've ever been.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。で、どしたの渡来さん」
lines.english: “Right. So what happened, Watarai?”

lines.japanese: 「来年のお正月に獅子舞やりたいって話になったんだけど、あの被り物をどうやって手に入れるか話し合ってたとこ」
lines.english: “We got to talking about doing a lion dance next New Year's, and we were discussing how to get hold of the lion head.”

lines.japanese: 「山科、おまえも参加したいならなまはげ役で協力させてやってもいいぞ。柳木原の駅前で獅子舞となまはげのリアルファイトだ。テレビ中継くらいされるかもしれないぞ」
lines.english: “Yamashina, if you want in, I'll let you help as the New Year's ogre. A live lion-dance-versus-ogre showdown in front of Yanagihara Station. We might even make television.”

lines.japanese: 「面白そうだけど、その日の体調に自信がもてないからやめとく」
lines.english: “Sounds fun, but I can't be sure I'll be feeling well that day, so I'll pass.”

lines.japanese: 山科は目を閉じながら、口に入れたパンをもくもくと咀嚼した。
lines.english: Yamashina closed her eyes and chewed her bread in silence.

lines.japanese: そしてこくんと飲みこんで、珍しく机の上に体を乗りだしてきた。
lines.english: Then she swallowed with a small gulp and, unusually for her, leaned over the desk toward us.

lines.japanese: 「代わりに今日の夜はどう？」
lines.english: “What about tonight instead?”

lines.japanese: 「なまはげか？」
lines.english: “As the ogre?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ストリートライブ」
lines.english: “No. A street gig.”

lines.japanese: 機嫌は良さそうだけど、俺の駄ボケにツッコミは入れてくれなかった。
lines.english: She seemed cheerful enough, but she didn't bother correcting my rotten joke.

lines.japanese: 「ストリート？　ていうと駅前によくいるような？」
lines.english: “Street? You mean like the performers you see in front of the station?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、実は私もホントかどうか分からないんだけど……」
lines.english: “No. The truth is, I don't even know if it's true...”

lines.japanese: 俺は山科を見上げながら、コンビニで買った味噌汁をずずずと啜った。山科の頬に赤みが差してる時点でなんとなく話は見えたからだ。
lines.english: I looked up at Yamashina while noisily sipping the miso soup I had bought at the convenience store. The color rising in her cheeks had already told me roughly where this was going.

lines.japanese: 「掲示板の友達が、駅前でロックバードのドラマーが演奏してるって教えてくれたの。前から噂では聞いてたんだけど、苦手な知り合いもいるから、見に行ったことはなかったんだ」
lines.english: “A friend from a message board told me Rockbird's drummer has been performing in front of the station. I'd heard the rumors before, but somebody I have trouble dealing with goes there too, so I've never gone to see him.”

lines.japanese: 「でも羽田君や渡来さんとなら見に行きたいなと思って」
lines.english: “But I thought I'd like to see it if you and Watarai came with me.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ？」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 俺は返事をしなかったけど、渡来と同じ感想を持った。山科が自分から誘ってくれるとは思わなかった。
lines.english: I didn't answer, but my reaction was the same as Watarai's. I hadn't expected Yamashina to invite us anywhere herself.

lines.japanese: 「悪い」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: でも断った。理由は多分隣の女も同じ。
lines.english: But I turned her down. Probably for the same reason as the woman beside me.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、ドラムのひとは趣味じゃないから」
lines.english: “Sorry. The drummer isn’t my type.”

lines.japanese: いや、渡来の方が一枚上手だ。俺は吹きだしそうになるのを堪えるのに必死だった。
lines.english: No. Watarai had outdone me. It took everything I had not to burst out laughing.

lines.japanese: 「そっか、でも仕方ないよね」
lines.english: “Oh. Well, I guess it can't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 山科は思ったより残念そうじゃなかった。たぶん俺と渡来に断られるのが分かってたんだと思う。
lines.english: Yamashina did not look as disappointed as I expected. She had probably known that Watarai and I would refuse.

lines.japanese: そんな山科と話がしたかったので、そのあと三人で初詣のことなんかをテーマに昼休みをだらだらと過ごした。
lines.english: I still wanted to talk with her, so the three of us idled away the rest of lunch talking about things like our first shrine visit of the New Year.

lines.japanese: ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ
lines.english: Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep.

lines.japanese: ぷるるるるっ……
lines.english: Brrrrring...

lines.japanese: 「はーい、もしもすぃー？」
lines.english: “Heeey, hellooo?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、森里君こんにちは」
lines.english: “Oh, hello, Morisato.”

lines.japanese: 「おー、また電話してくれたん。ありがとね」
lines.english: “Hey. You called me again. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 森里君の傷は本人曰くほとんど治っていて、病院にいるのが退屈らしい。彼からかけてくることはなかったけど、大体のときはこうして電話に出てくれる。
lines.english: According to Morisato, his injuries were almost completely healed, and he was bored stiff in the hospital. He never called me, but most of the time he picked up when I called him like this.

lines.japanese: 「で、どーなん。なんか変わったことあった？」
lines.english: “So, how're things? Anything happen?”

lines.japanese: 「学校では特にないよ。まあ普通かな」
lines.english: “Nothing much at school. The usual, really.”

lines.japanese: 「学校ではってことは、他になんかあんの？」
lines.english: “At school? Meaning something happened somewhere else?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、大したことは……」
lines.english: “No, well, nothing important...”

lines.japanese: 「ああそうだ、不良青年たちがペガサスいなくて寂しいと嘆いていたよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. The young delinquents were lamenting how terribly lonely they are without Pegasus.”

lines.japanese: 嘆いてなかったかもしれないが、俺には彼らの心の声が聞こえたのだ。そう、それだ。
lines.english: Maybe they hadn't technically lamented anything, but I could hear the cries of their hearts. Right. That was it.

lines.japanese: 「あー、つか、あんまり病院には来ないでくださいっつってあるから」
lines.english: “Oh, them. I mean, I kinda told them not to visit me at the hospital too much.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？　かわいそうだよ、お見舞いくらい好きにさせてあげなよ」
lines.english: “Why? That's so sad. At least let them come visit whenever they want.”

lines.japanese: 「んじゃ羽田だったら呼ぶわけ？」
lines.english: “You'd invite them if you were me?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　呼ぶわけねーだろハゲ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Huh? Like hell I would, baldy. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「かかか、ま、あのひとたちが来ると見舞いどころじゃないかんね」
lines.english: “Ka-ka-ka! Well, when those guys show up, you can hardly call it a hospital visit anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「一回くらいは見舞いに来たんだろ？　そのときはどーだったのよ」
lines.english: “They came at least once, right? How'd that go?”

lines.japanese: 「酷いよ。大輔は看護師のお姉さんにちょっかいかけるわ、チケドンさんは薬剤部見にいくわ……ＬＲさんも病室でフリースタイルラップ始めるしさあ」
lines.english: “It was awful. Daisuke hit on the nurses, Chikedon wandered off to inspect the pharmacy... Even LR started freestyling right there in my room.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、元気がいいなあ」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! High-spirited bunch, aren't they?”

lines.japanese: その光景が容易に想像できた。シャレが通じないっていうか、この世の森羅万象すべてがシャレだと思ってる人種だからな。
lines.english: The whole scene was easy to picture. It wasn't so much that they couldn't take a joke as that they belonged to a species that considered all creation one enormous joke.

lines.japanese: 「彼ら、なんかＲ－ウイングの連中が言うこと聞かないとかで困ってたぞ。森里君、助けてあげたら？」
lines.english: “They were having trouble because the R-Wing guys wouldn't do what they were told. Why don't you help them out, Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、あいつら……つか、俺が何か言って聞くような連中じゃねーもん」
lines.english: “Oh, those guys... I mean, they're not gonna listen just because I tell them something.”

lines.japanese: 「なあ？　そんなこと相談されても困るよなあ？」
lines.english: “Right? What am I supposed to do when they come asking me about that?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで羽田が困んの？　ま、いーケド」
lines.english: “Why're you the one in trouble, Haneda? Eh, whatever.”

lines.japanese: 森里君が息を大きく吐く音が聞こえた。タバコは吸わないクリーンな不良だから、ため息でもついたのかな。
lines.english: I heard Morisato breathe out heavily. He was the clean-living kind of delinquent who didn't smoke, so I supposed it was a sigh.

lines.japanese: 「ま、近いうちに俺も退院すっからさ。そしたらまた現場にでも遊びに行くわ」
lines.english: “Anyway, I'll be outta here pretty soon. Then I'll come hang out at the job site again.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあっ！？」
lines.english: “W-whaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「いや森里君さ、来るならフツーに学校来てよ。なんでわざわざ仕事場来るの」
lines.english: “Morisato, if you're coming back, come to school like a normal person. Why go out of your way to visit my job?”

lines.japanese: 「あヤベッ！　いま屋上じゃねーのに看護師さん来ちゃったよ！」
lines.english: “Oh, crap! I'm not on the roof this time and a nurse just came in!”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよオイィィィ！」
lines.english: “LISTEN TO ME, DAMMIT!”

lines.japanese: 「んじゃまたなー。もーすぐ退院できっと思うからさ」
lines.english: “Later. Think I'll be outta here real soon.”

lines.japanese: 「思うからじゃないだろ、ちょっと待て、だから来るならせめて家に……」
lines.english: “That's not a reason—wait! If you're coming anywhere, at least come to my house—”

lines.japanese: プツッ！　ツー　ツー　ツー……
lines.english: Click! Beep... beep... beep...

lines.japanese: しかし無情にもそこで会話は強制的に終了させられた。もしかしたら看護師さんに切られたのかもしれない。
lines.english: And there our conversation was mercilessly terminated. Maybe the nurse had hung up on him.

lines.japanese: つーかやっぱ森里君もあいつらと同レベルだわ。俺は額に手を当てながらとぼとぼと帰路についた。
lines.english: Yeah. Morisato really was on exactly the same level as the rest of them. Hand pressed to my forehead, I trudged home.
